encyclopedia.summary: An action adventure made by Vigil Games in 2010. War, one of the four horsemen, is tricked into taking the blame for humanity's end and sets out to find out why. Swapping between sword and scythe in combat and solving dungeon puzzles puts it close to the older Zelda formula. Later games hand the lead to a different horseman each time.
highlights: Each dungeon's new tool changes both the next dungeon's puzzles and the fighting.
The weapon pairings and combos are simple but land clearly.
Its character design gives each figure of the apocalypse a distinct build and way of speaking.
